findings.description: Function _extract_input_images has high cyclomatic complexity due to nested loops and multiple conditionals
findings.remediation: Refactor to extract inner loops into helper functions and reduce nesting depth

findings.description: Function _run_with_session exceeds 100 lines, making it difficult to read and maintain
findings.remediation: Break into smaller functions: one for processing steps, one for handling events, one for tool execution

findings.description: Provider implementations (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI) share similar structures for tool handling and event streaming
findings.remediation: Extract common functionality into a base provider class to reduce duplication

findings.description: Fixed batch size of 20 for image processing tools may not be optimal for all use cases, potentially causing inefficient API usage
findings.remediation: Make batch size configurable based on workload characteristics or implement dynamic batching

findings.description: Agent processing lacks overall timeout, relying only on max_steps limit which may not prevent excessively long runs
findings.remediation: Add configurable timeout for overall agent processing in addition to max_steps limit
